text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm out one day to grab some magazines when I happen to see Fuji Kiseki and Zenno Rob Roy together.
choice_data_list: Well, aren't you an unlikely pair.
Well, aren't you an unlikely pair.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Hehe. I'm Rob Roy's sister today.
choice_data_list: I'm sorry, what?
I'm sorry, what?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Um, well… It all started when I first got here…

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: I'm still a ways off from the bookstore… Oh, I hope they'll still have signed copies of the book I want…

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Urgh… Being in such a fancy place is just too much for me!

text_block_list.name: Scammer A (Woman)
text_block_list.text: Hey there, miss! Can I interest you in a jar of fortune?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Wha?! A-are you talking to me? Sorry, I… I have somewhere to be…

text_block_list.name: Scammer A (Woman)
text_block_list.text: Aw, don't be like that! ♪ Look, our store's right around the corner!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: There you are, Rob Roy! Sorry I'm late.

text_block_list.name: Scammer A (Woman)
text_block_list.text: Oh, so you were waiting for your sister! Why don't you both come check out our wares?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Sorry, but we have to drop off something we found at the police station. Our mom works there, so she'll know what to do with it.

text_block_list.name: Scammer A (Woman)
text_block_list.text: Your mom's a cop?! …Ahem. I mean, it's too bad you're busy, but oh well! ♪

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Th-thanks for that… I didn't know how to get out of that situation alone…

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: It's no problem! But what are you doing here, anyway? Is there a book you want that you can't get anywhere else?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: That's exactly it! A store nearby is selling signed copies of my favorite mystery writer's newest book!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Huh. Well, would it be all right if I accompanied you?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: There's a book I want to buy too. And besides, I'm too worried about letting my dear little sister go there by herself.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: So, I'm going to be Rob Roy's personal bodyguard until we reach the bookstore.
choice_data_list: In that case, I'll be your bodyguard!
In that case, I'll be your bodyguard!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Can you really protect me?
choice_data_list: I am older than you, you know!
I am older than you, you know!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Does that make you my overprotective older brother, then?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: How fun! Looks like shopping is getting more and more exciting!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Thankfully, the bookstore does still have signed copies of the book Zenno Rob Roy wants.
choice_data_list: Wait, where's Fuji?

text_block_list.name: Scammer B (Woman)
text_block_list.text: Like I said, if you debut with our company, you're sure to become rich and famous! I guarantee it!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Thanks for your offer, but I have no intention of changing careers.
choice_data_list: What do you want with my sister?

text_block_list.name: Scammer B (Woman)
text_block_list.text: Oh my! Are you her brother? I was just offering your sibling a chance to make it big in the world of entertainment!

text_block_list.text: Oh my! Are you her sister? I was just offering your sibling a chance to make it big in the world of entertainment!

text_block_list.name: Scammer B (Woman)
text_block_list.text: She said she'd rather continue racing than become an entertainer, but don't you think she'd be better off in show business?
choice_data_list: No, actually, because I respect my sister's wishes.

text_block_list.name: Scammer B (Woman)
text_block_list.text: But come on! Just look at her! She's clearly better suited to a life filled with glitz and glam, not sweat and dirt!
choice_data_list: Say what you want, but her dream is to race.

text_block_list.name: Scammer B (Woman)
text_block_list.text: Ugh… Fine. Don't say I didn't try to give you a chance.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Wow! I can't believe you were scouted like that, Fuji!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: "Talent scouts" like that are usually scammers. They're nothing to get starry-eyed over.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Also… Thanks for defending my dream. I'm glad I have an older brother who's so supportive of me.
choice_data_list: You're very welcome!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Hehe. I'm so glad my older siblings are such wonderful people.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Hehe. I'm so glad my older sisters are such wonderful people.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After that, we dip into a cafe for a break, then head back home. It's fully dark by the time we reach the academy.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Thank you so much for everything today! I'll be sure to pay you back for your kindness!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I'd better go too. It was fun having you as my older brother today.
choice_data_list: I can be your older brother whenever you'd like.
I can be your older sister whenever you'd like.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I'd better go too. It was fun having you as my older sister today.

text_block_list.text: Hehe, thanks. But I'll be your bodyguard next time.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Knowing you were there to protect me today made me happy, but I want to show off my cool side too.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: And that goes double when I'm showing off to my older brother.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: And that goes double when I'm showing off to my older sister.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She winks mischievously at me, and I laugh. Whatever she wishes for or dreams of, I'll be there to make sure they come true.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I tell them that their hair and eye color are so similar, I'm sure nobody would raise an eyebrow if they claimed to be sisters.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: But Fuji is so wonderful, and I'm nothing like her… I couldn't possibly claim to be her sister…

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Why not, though? I'd love to have a sister like you. Every day would be so fun!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: We could talk about plays together. After all, you always have the most interesting story analysis!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Th-thank you. I always have a great time when we talk too.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I'm honored to hear that. Now come on, little sister! Off to the bookstore we go! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Since I was headed for the bookstore myself, we all go together.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Oh, I'm so glad I finally got a copy! Thank you, both of you!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: No problem. By the way, do you two happen to be free after this?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: The theaters are showing a live broadcast of the play my mother's in, and I was wondering if you'd like to watch it together.
choice_data_list: Sure! Sounds fun!
Sure! Sounds fun!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: I'd love to go as well!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We make our way to the movie theater and enjoy the play together.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Fuji Kiseki's mother is still as popular as ever. Her performance, as always, captures the hearts of everyone watching.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Ah… That was incredible. I wish I could rewatch the part where they made an oath together.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Me too! I was so moved by the scene where they hinted that the river wolf was the reincarnation of the protagonist's late mother!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Wait, if the river wolf was the mother… Hm, that would entirely change the meaning of that fight scene…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Fuji Kiseki is bright and animated as she talks about the play. She seems so happy to have found a kindred spirit in Zenno Rob Roy.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: U-um, what's the matter? Is there something on my face?
choice_data_list: No, sorry. I was just thinking about how well you two get along.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I feel the same. If you don't mind, Rob Roy, I'd love to watch another play with you sometime and discuss it after.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: O-oh, if you don't think I'd be a bother, I'd be delighted to join you!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: They seemed like an odd pair at first, but after a day together, it's clear they're sisters in all but blood.
